{{Quote|Don't encourage them, kid....They'll turn you into a Mandalorian. You wouldn't want that.|Ennen|<ref name="Imp Commando" />}}
'''Ennen''', also identified as '''IC-4447''', was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] and a member of [[Galaar Squad]], trained by a [[Unidentified Corellian Cuy'val Dar instructor|Corellian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Cuy'val Dar]] to serve the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

After [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was enacted and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] established the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Galaar [[Squad/Legends|Squad]] was disbanded. Ennen, along with his squadmate, [[Bry (clone trooper)|Bry]], were combined with [[Omega Squad]]'s [[Niner Skirata|Niner]] and [[Darman Skirata]] to form [[Squad 40]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="Imp Commando" /> On their [[Mission to Celen|first mission]] as a squad, they were sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celen]] to capture [[Jilam Kester]], an [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] who was helping [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escape from the Empire. Upon storming the building where Kester was residing, the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] came face to face with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Iri Camas]], who had previously led [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] commandos as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]]. Camas distracted the commandos, allowing Kester to escape, and ended his own life by igniting a gas line and causing the building to explode. Bry was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Camas prior to the explosion, while the rest of the squad managed to escape.<ref name="Imp Commando" />

Following Bry's death, Ennen became withdrawn and depressed.<ref name="Imp Commando" /> When Squad 40 was sent on a mission to hunt down a Jedi on Coruscant, they successfully trapped the man. Ennen killed him; but they later discovered that the supposed Jedi was just a simple thief who had happened upon a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Later, in the [[Refresher/Legends|refreshers]] of the barracks, Ennen committed suicide, shooting himself with his [[DC-15s side arm blaster]].<ref name="Imp Commando" />
